title: Umphrofethi
summary: This translation by Lungile Dlamini is a timely gift of immeasurable proportions to her people. She is unequivocal in her offering, as articulated in her appeal to her readers: “Fundani le ncwadi, niyidlulisele nakwabanye njengesipho sengqondo nenhliziyo ejulayo ngomcabango".
